findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` instead of rejecting access. This bypasses the function’s tenant boundary and permits cross-tenant document disclosure.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
Returning `true` allows every user to read every document. Any call where `userTenant !== documentTenant` now bypasses tenant authorization and can expose cross-tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label contract
findings.body:
Consumers that compare, serialize, map, or test the exported label as `"Document"` now receive `"Document record"`, breaking the existing exact-value API contract.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document authorization
findings.body:
Returning `true` allows any user to read documents belonging to another tenant whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, causing a cross-tenant data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
